Many-headed Marsh Wyrm (CV 62)

A massive marsh reptile with three long necks rising from one low, muscular body. The heads share a single purpose and body, whose wounds knit unless scorched by fire.

Attributes: Brawn +2; Fortitude +2; Agility +0; Guile -1; Knowledge -2; Reason +1

HP: 48 · Speed: 5; swim 7 · Size: 3 (3x3 squares) · Armor DR: 2

Evasion: 1 Boon · Threat: 1 Bane · Stability: 2

Weaknesses: Fire (see details)\ Resistances: Physical (2)\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates one complete outcome. All attacks use the printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Crossing jaws

A great limb scythes across the ground, forcing everyone nearby to move.

Target: Up to two creatures within 2 squares. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Anchoring bite

One head holds the prey while the others watch its companions.

Target: One creature within 2 squares. Player defense: Brawn. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: Grappled 2. Standard defense: Grappled 1.

Limit: The holder suffers its own Grappled contribution. A new result replaces its lower contribution, not adds to it. Release freely; separation beyond reach, unconsciousness or death ends the hold.

Tail Retort

The dragon twists with the blow and its heavy tail sweeps across the attacker's footing.

After an adjacent attacker's attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, push that attacker 2 squares directly away. This creature must survive and remain capable. Apply Stability, terrain costs and normal collision damage; no separate attack damage. Cannot trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

Heavy Frame — Passive: Stability 2; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

Weakness: Fire damage suppresses Knit Flesh until its next recovery.

Knit Flesh: At turn end, recover 3 HP if above 0, unless it took fire damage since its previous turn end. Dies at 0; cannot regrow from death.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Signs: Several bite sizes mark the same carcass beside an immense trail.

Purpose: Guard a deep feeding pool.

Tactics and retreat: Sweep two targets with separate heads; regenerate until fire forces it to retreat.

Counterplay and conversation: Use fire and high ground; multiple heads do not give it multiple turns.

Habitat: Deep marsh; lake · Communication: None

Loot: One old wreck in its pool may hold 120 coins of recoverable cargo.

Summoning: Ineligible.

Design notes — not needed during play

CV worksheet

Difficulty rationale: A slow or broad exposed body gives the attacker a Boon. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

Reference damage: 5/7/9

Reference type: physical

Expected targets: 2

Utility factor: 1.45

Action review (#1279): U 1.3 → 1.45: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.15. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

Regeneration per turn: 3

Reference I=3.596, O=13.191. CV uses the seed worksheet; action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.
